text.name: Kyogre

attacks.name: Aqua Storm
attacks.text: Discard the top 5 cards of your deck, and then choose 2 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. This attack does 50 damage for each Energy card you discarded in this way to each of those Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

text.flavor: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

text.name: Manaphy

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Wave Veil
abilities.text: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

text.flavor: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

text.name: Radiant Greninja

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Concealed Cards
abilities.text: You must discard an Energy card from your hand in order to use this Ability. Once during your turn, you may draw 2 cards.

attacks.name: Moonlight Shuriken
attacks.text: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon. This attack does 90 damage to 2 of your opponent's Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.label: Radiant Pokémon Rule
rules.text: You can't have more than 1 Radiant Pokémon in your deck.

text.flavor: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Fleet-Footed
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may draw a card.

attacks.name: Lightning Rondo
attacks.text: This attack does 20 more damage for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).

rules.label: V rule
rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

text.name: Cramorant

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Lost Provisions
abilities.text: If you have 4 or more cards in the Lost Zone, ignore all Energy in this Pokémon's attack costs.

attacks.name: Spit Innocently
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness.

text.flavor: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.

text.name: PokéStop
effect: Once during each player's turn, that player may discard 3 cards from the top of their deck. If a player discarded any Item cards in this way, they put those Item cards into their hand.

rules.text: This Stadium stays in play when you play it. Discard it if another Stadium comes into play. If a Stadium with the same name is in play, you can't play this card.

text.name: Sableye

attacks.name: Lost Mine
attacks.text: You can use this attack only if you have 10 or more cards in the Lost Zone. Put 12 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

text.flavor: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.

text.name: Comfey

abilities.label: Ability
abilities.name: Flower Selecting
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card in the Lost Zone.

text.flavor: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

text.name: Energy Recycler
effect: Shuffle up to 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Escape Rope
effect: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.)

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Echoing Horn
effect: Put a Basic Pokémon from your opponent's discard pile onto their Bench.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Klara
effect: Choose 1 or both:
• Put up to 2 Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
• Put up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your hand.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Hisuian Heavy Ball
effect: Look at your face-down Prize cards. You may reveal a Basic Pokémon you find there, put it into your hand, and put this Hisuian Heavy Ball in its place as a face-down Prize card. (If you don't reveal a Basic Pokémon, put this card in the discard pile.) Then, shuffle your face-down Prize cards.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Switch Cart
effect: Switch your Active Basic Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If you do, heal 30 damage from the Pokémon you moved to your Bench.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Colress's Experiment
effect: Look at the top 5 cards of your deck and put 3 of them into your hand. Put the other cards in the Lost Zone.

rules.text: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn.

text.name: Forest Seal Stone

abilities.label: VSTAR Power
abilities.name: Star Alchemy
abilities.text: During your turn, you may search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can't use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)

effect: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card.

rules.label: Pokémon Tool
rules.text: Attach a Pokémon Tool to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't already have a Pokémon Tool attached.
You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Lost Vacuum
effect: You can use this card only if you put another card from your hand in the Lost Zone.
Choose a Pokémon Tool attached to any Pokémon, or any Stadium in play, and put it in the Lost Zone.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Mirage Gate
effect: You can use this card only if you have 7 or more cards in the Lost Zone.
Search your deck for up to 2 basic Energy cards of different types and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Nest Ball
effect: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Pal Pad
effect: Shuffle up to 2 Supporter cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Super Rod
effect: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

text.name: Battle VIP Pass
effect: You can use this card only during your first turn.
Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

rules.text: You may play any number of Item cards during your turn.

attacks.name: Shred
attacks.text: This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dragon Gale
attacks.text: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

rules.text: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.
